up: Retrieve up to 500 distinct compounds (molecule_chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles) that exhibit Ki values below 100 nM against human single-protein targets. Filter the activities table for standard_type = 'Ki', standard_units = 'nM', and standard_value < 100. Join assays with target_dictionary to enforce target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Return distinct compounds only, capped at 500 rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'Ki' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_value < 100 AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' LIMIT 500
